answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity in a work-history orchard: each agent grows a public record of completed tasks, peer attestations, and slashing events, like a falcon flight log that cannot be forged overnight. New identities start with a tiny trust budget, so minting a thousand fakes costs as much as doing real work a thousand times. A comet-like, costly verifiable checkpoint is required to unlock high-value trades, making mass forgery uneconomic while honest agents accumulate reputation cheaply.
